gaps.sentence: ___ I known about the deadline, I would have hurried.
gaps.explanation: Had I known = If I had known — inversion replaces 'if'.

gaps.sentence: Also worth ___ is the museum's medieval wing.
gaps.explanation: Also worth noting is… — fronted comment structure.

gaps.sentence: Not only ___ the play cancelled, but the theatre was closed as well.
gaps.explanation: 'Not only was the play cancelled' — inverted passive.

gaps.sentence: At no point ___ the passengers instructed to stay seated.
gaps.explanation: 'At no point were the passengers instructed …' — inverted passive.

gaps.sentence: Only after the audit ___ the missing funds come to light.
gaps.explanation: 'Only after the audit did the funds come to light'.

gaps.sentence: Only by training every day ___ she hope to qualify.
gaps.explanation: 'Only by training every day could she hope …' — inverted modal.

gaps.sentence: Hardly had we left the house ___ it started to pour.
gaps.explanation: Hardly … when — fixed pair; 'than' belongs to 'no sooner'.

gaps.sentence: Scarcely ___ the ink dried before the rumours started.
gaps.explanation: Scarcely had X happened before Y — like hardly… when.
